summary: The dnf5 module manages packages with dnf5, which is still under development and lacks some dnf module features. It can locate or auto-install python3-libdnf5 and respawn under the right interpreter.
questions: Should I use dnf5 or dnf module on Fedora?
Why does dnf5 module complain about python3-libdnf5?
Does dnf5 support all features of the dnf module?

answer_card.title: dnf5 module overview
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.dnf5` manages packages with dnf5. It's still under development and not all `dnf` module options are implemented. If `python3-libdnf5` can't be imported, it checks system interpreters and may install it (`auto_install_module_deps`), then respawns.
